title: promote-latest.mjs: ensureGitHubRelease makes one attempt, so an upstream HTTP 500 still leaves the Release uncut
description: Follow-up from the LCLI-689 review (NOTE 11). After LCLI-689 a lagging read no longer skips the GitHub Release step, but ensureGitHubRelease still makes a single attempt: an upstream GitHub HTTP 500 (as on 0.13.0, 2026-10-07) leaves the Release uncut at exit 3, needing an out-of-band repair. Consider a bounded retry. Not built in LCLI-689.
